nodes.description: www.commonroom.io renders with fast edge-cached responses, keeping TTFB around 930ms. Architecture: Deploy on edge CDN nodes (e.g. Cloudflare / Vercel Edge). Cache static assets with immutable cache-control, revalidate dynamic data with SWR or React Query.

nodes.description: Consistent typography, high-contrast dark theme surfaces, and smooth micro-animations across all interactive surfaces.
